name: When is drywall sanding typically performed during a construction project?

mainEntity.name: When is drywall sanding typically performed during a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall sanding is typically performed after the drywall sheets are hung, and all joint compound applications (taping, filling, and finishing coats) have fully dried. This usually involves multiple drying periods between coats. It's one of the final steps before priming and painting. Rushing this stage can lead to visible seams and imperfections in the finished wall or ceiling. Ensuring adequate drying time for the compound is essential before any sanding begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall sanding occurs after all joint compound applications have completely dried, just before priming and painting, as a final preparation step.
